name: Review of Brind Summer Vacation
original_name: レビューオフ Brind Summer Vacation
source:
Main character is an upcoming manga writer with one magical girl story to receive anime adaptation. He organizes a party to meet offline with the fans. Thirteen people have gathered, but even though nicknames are known, noone knows each others faces. What will come out of this party?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位即将出道的漫画作家，他的一个魔法少女故事将被改编成动画。他组织了一场聚会，与粉丝线下见面。十三个人聚集在一起，虽然知道绰号，却无人认得对方的长相。这次聚会会产生什么结果？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
